purpose: Make silent graph dataflow errors loud, and use the new guarantee to enumerate the remaining ones.
why_this_matters: The original MLA bug was silent: a graph operand referenced an activation that did not exist, and the executor quietly substituted the running hidden vector. That single silent fallback produced a latent with cosine 0.028 and every downstream block diverged. A guard that converts this class of error into an explicit failure prevents recurrence.
changes: resolveIn now fails closed: a named operand absent from the arena is recorded in unresolved_inputs_ instead of being replaced with hidden_. ExecuteToken returns false when the list is non-empty.
MlaDecompress is explicitly exempted because its a/b/c are all weight slots by contract; its activation now rides in o.detail and is resolved by the call site.
The graph carry is now explicit: MlaDecompress sets o.detail = "attn_norm" so the activation is named rather than implied.

The Router handler publishes its logits into the arena under its declared output name, so the TopK that consumes router_logits resolves a real operand. Previously the Router only wrote expert_ids/expert_w and never the arena, which the new guard immediately caught.
what_the_guard_revealed: blk.N.attn_kv_a_mqa.weight was being resolved as an activation on every layer - the a slot of an op whose slots are all weights. Fixed by the detail-based activation carry.
router_logits was consumed by TopK but never produced. Fixed by publishing the Router output.
After both fixes the guard reports no unresolved operands, and the harness returns 18/18 PASS.

remaining_defect.symptom: argmax is constant at token 21632 across positions 0-3 while logits vary per position, and generated text degenerates.
remaining_defect.measured_boundary: 21632 already dominates at position 0 by a margin of roughly 16 over the runner-up tokens (22674/-16.4, 7697/-16.4, 30843/-14.3).
remaining_defect.why_this_localizes_it: At position 0 every layer sees T=1, so attention contributes no cross-position signal and MoE routing is driven by a single token. A defect that produces a fixed ~16-margin token at position 0 therefore cannot be attention or MoE: it must be in the final normalization, the residual stream, or the output projection. Logits varying while argmax stays fixed is the signature of a dominant direction in the hidden vector, not a ranking error.
remaining_defect.next_step: Dump the final-norm output at positions 0 and 3, project both onto output.weight row 21632, and compare that direction against the runner-up rows. This distinguishes a final-norm error from an output-projection row-magnitude error.
